item.tlipoca.guest_ledger.desc: It records guest names, and the wishes they never say aloud.
item.tlipoca.faded_invitation.desc: If you are willing to leave a lamp lit, place the table where fog may pass.
item.tlipoca.memory_fragment.desc: Light as a small dream someone forgot to take back.
item.tlipoca.fog_dew.desc: The bottle is cold at the bottom. It makes no sound when shaken.
item.tlipoca.old_theater_ticket.desc: The seat number has faded, but the gate still seems to be waiting.
item.tlipoca.soul_receipt.desc: A small receipt whose total is always left blank.
item.tlipoca.moondew_leaf.desc: A leaf that gathers dew only when the yard's night holds steady.
item.tlipoca.star_honey.desc: Sweet as a bedtime story, with an aftertaste from very far away.
item.tlipoca.oracle_ink.desc: Before the question is written, the ink already knows the price.
